environment: prod (Entra ID tenant + shared Azure DevOps project platform-prod)

changes.title: Rotate app registration owners for pipelines-prod
changes.notes: Quarterly ownership rotation. Ownership metadata only — credentials, redirect URIs and federated identity model untouched.

changes.title: Edit federated credential on pipelines-prod
changes.diff: federatedIdentityCredentials: description 'prod pipeline credential' -> 'prod pipeline credential (managed centrally)'
changes.notes: Description-only edit for inventory hygiene. Issuer, subject, audiences and the credential's token-exchange path are unchanged.

changes.title: Restrict kv-infra-secrets firewall to corp ranges
changes.diff: networkAcls: defaultAction Allow -> Deny; virtualNetworkRules += corp-vnet-3
changes.notes: kv-infra-secrets holds infra team secrets only. Pipeline variable groups read from kv-prod-shared, a different vault with unchanged ACLs.

changes.title: Refactor azure-pipelines.yml stage templates
changes.diff: stages extracted to templates/stages-v2.yml; jobs renamed deploy -> deploy-webapp
changes.notes: Mechanical template refactor. AzureCLI@2 login steps and service connections untouched; ran green in the staging project at 07:41.

changes.title: Tune pipeline retention and badge settings
changes.diff: runs retention: 30 days -> 60 days; public badge access: off -> private
changes.notes: Retention and badge visibility only — no execution, agent pool or service connection setting touched.

changes.title: Expand 'Require compliant device' policy to All cloud apps
changes.notes: Phase 2 of the device-trust rollout: the policy previously covered one legacy CRM app only and now targets All cloud apps. Workload-identity sign-ins were not excluded because the policy was assumed to apply to interactive users.
